precepts.why:
The last empire, the dragon with seven heads and ten horns, has attributes like a lion, which was ancient Babylon, and Daniel 3 is Babylon setting up its golden image. You may read that and say it was back then. But evangelical leaders just gathered at Trump National Doral in Miami, and again at Mar-a-Lago, to bless and dedicate a 22 foot gold leaf statue of Trump, Don Colossus, with his fist raised. Pastor Mark Burns led the dedication and said it was not a golden calf, the pastors prayed over the image, and Trump called in to thank them. You see the comparison with Daniel 3.

Revelation 13 shows who is behind that image. “And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.” This is the white man as Rome, the Roman Catholic Church, the mother of all Christian denominations, blaspheming the name of the Lord.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”. The twelve tribes of Israel are the saints. This white man orchestrated war against us under Pope Nicholas V, and he overcame us and enslaved us. Pastor Burns doesn't have a clue: these people made war against us and enslaved us. “and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: that is how the white race became the dominant race on the planet.

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”. Everybody on this earth worships the white man as God, as Jesus, as the angels, as the Jews. Show a Muslim or a Buddhist that image and ask whose it is, and they will say Jesus, Christ. Some of your mothers and fathers, sisters and brothers and children worship him.

Even the show The Boys patterns it: the Homelander character, with blonde hair like Trump, becomes president, mixes evangelical Christians into politics, and says his destiny is not serving the Lord but being the Lord, the Messiah, the saviour of the world. The thing that has been is that which shall be. Nebuchadnezzar set up a one world religion with his image, and it is the same thing they are trying to do today. What we read in Daniel 3 we see coming to pass.

precepts.why:
That was Babylon; now the Greek captivity, to show that this judgment is like a ring. “Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.” It is the same as Nebuchadnezzar calling all people, nations and languages to fall down before one image.

“Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.” Just like we saw with Pastor Mark Burns, praying over a golden statue.

The king sent letters “that they should follow the strange laws of the land”, forbid the offerings in the temple, “profane the sabbaths and festival days”, “Set up altars, and groves, and chapels of idols, and sacrifice swine’s flesh, and unclean beasts”, and leave their children uncircumcised. Why? “To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.” That was the purpose of setting up these things: that we would forget God's law.

“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.” It is the fiery furnace of Babylon again. The same idolatry we read about in Babylon happened in Greece, and it is going to continue. Don't think America is absolved from this; we are seeing elements of it now. Some of you have been swooned to sleep, thinking nothing is ever going to happen here, and now you see a big gold statue set up and say, well, he hasn't made anybody pray to it yet.

So stand like Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego: “But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.” They knew you cannot force the Lord to deliver you, and that the body is temporary but the spirit lives on. These events will occur again, and these are the things we have to learn and put in our hearts, minds and souls.

precepts.text: Nebuchadnezzar made an image of gold and decreed that whoever fell not down and worshipped it should be cast into the burning fiery furnace.
precepts.point: Daniel told him he would be driven from men to eat grass until he knew the Most High ruleth in the kingdom of men. Twelve months later he said, Is not this great Babylon that I have built by the might of my power? While the word was in his mouth, the kingdom departed from him. He humbled himself and confessed there is no God like Daniel's God.

note.label: The Pride Of Thine Heart

precepts.why:
Nebuchadnezzar is the head of gold in Daniel's dream, and before God humbled him in chapter 4, his pride is shown in chapter 3: “Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.” In his pride he set up a golden image and said everybody should worship it.

He gathered the princes, the governors, the captains, the judges and all the rulers of the provinces to its dedication, and “an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages”, that when they heard the music they should “fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up”. And “whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.”

That is the same thing America does now with the flag. You don't bow down to it; now you have to stand up and salute it and honor it. It is the same as it was in ancient Babylon, just a different way.

This is why the decree of Daniel 4 came upon him. Nebuchadnezzar got prideful, and pride brings a man low. Twelve months after Daniel's interpretation he said, “Is not this great Babylon, that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power, and for the honour of my majesty?” God calls America Babylon the great, and Nebuchadnezzar called Babylon great himself. “While the word was in the king’s mouth”, the kingdom departed from him. You try to make people worship you, and it is taken.

He was made to eat grass as oxen “until thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”. Until you humble yourself, you are eating grass. And he did humble himself; he came back and confessed there is no God like the God of Daniel. All kingdoms fall because of pride, Assyria, Babylon, the Greeks, Rome and America, and nobody is exempt from God's judgment for it.

precepts.text: Our God is able to deliver us and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king — but if not, we will not serve thy gods nor worship the golden image. Even unrescued they were willing to die for what they believed, and we have to get to that mindset.
precepts.point: When you go through things — health, children leaving this truth, the job, a wife or a husband who does not believe — go back to your forefathers, who went through things as well. It is harder for us: they all knew they were the Israelites, and our people have been cut off from that.

precepts.text: The three were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats; hosen when you look up that word is pants.
precepts.point: Ecclesiasticus gives the second account of these garments and confirms the breeches under the robe of glory. It also shows the pomegranates and bells compassed him, all around the hem and not four corners only, and that the crown of gold sat upon the mitre before Israel had any kings, because mediator between the Most High and His people is the highest honor; for the brothers given the honor to lead and teach among the nation, do not take it for granted or be slothful in it, for there is nothing more honorable to do on this earth.

note.label: Exodus 28: Holy Garments for Glory and for Beauty

precepts.why:
The Most High commanded “linen breeches to cover their nakedness; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach”. Breeches are pants; the grandmothers of the south said pull your britches up.

The three Hebrews “were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.” Look up hosen and it is defined with one word: pants. So this is where pants were ordained in the scriptures, upon Aaron and his sons, and Daniel shows the men of Israel wearing them.

precepts.text: Thou shalt have no other gods and make no graven image, nor bow down to them, for the Most High is a jealous God; we are not to bow and serve gods made by hands.
precepts.point: The reason we did not bow was according to the law.

note.label: Daniel 3: The Fiery Furnace and the Servants of the Most High

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt have no other gods before me. Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them”. That is the law, and that is the reason Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego did not bow. Nebuchadnezzar's golden image is a graven image, the likeness of a thing, made by hands, and the Most High commanded Israel not to bow down to such things nor serve them.

The Chaldeans put it plainly to the king: these men “serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.” Every word of the accusation was true. It was simply the three of them keeping the commandment; we are not to bow and serve gods made by hands, whatever decree a king makes.

“for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me”. The Most High is a jealous God; bowing to another god is hating him, and he visits it on the children after. So the reason we did not bow was according to the law.

precepts.text: The Most High is in the midst of Israel and none else, and his people shall never be ashamed.
precepts.point: When the nations get jacked up they come to know who has the real, true, living God; other heathen rulers came to the same acknowledgement, such as Antiochus and Naaman the Syrian.

note.label: Daniel 3: The Fiery Furnace and the Servants of the Most High

precepts.why:
“And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.” The Most High is in the midst of Israel and none else; he is our God, the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and they were not ashamed for trusting him. They “yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God”, and he sent his angel and delivered them.

Nebuchadnezzar understood at that time that we had our own God. He made a decree that any people, nation, or language which spake amiss against their God would be cut in pieces and their houses made a dunghill, “because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.” Why do people not understand that today? A heathen king in Babylon saw it and said it, and yet our people today do not know that Israel has its own God.

When the nations get jacked up they come to know who has the real, true, living God. Nebuchadnezzar is not the only one: Antiochus came to the same acknowledgement, and so did Naaman the Syrian. What the heathen kings had to learn by force, Joel says Israel shall know: the Lord is in the midst of Israel, and none else, and his people shall never be ashamed.
